[[Fungal Bloom]]s are stationary plant creatures that are somewhat resistant to damage. When attacked, it periodically creates a [[Fungal Spore]]. The spores are harmless by themselves but their use of [[Fungal Explosion]] will create [[Parasitic Growth]]s that ''will'' attack. Be careful when there are more than one Fungal Blooms. Focus on taking them down one by one because they become much more difficult to take out due to the overlapping paragon skill effects and the creation of Parasitic Growths.
